prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define REST services as named listener instances with stable logical identity separate from configurable port/listen binding and runtime state. [2] Define REST services using the same named-instance model as other listeners, with stable logical identity separate from configurable port/listener binding and explicit route-to-operation mappings.

semantics.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] REST route existence never bypasses AccessCore/IAM/operation authority. [2] HTTP reachability never substitutes for AccessCore authorization.
semantics.identity_rule: Each REST service has an explicit stable logical instance identity.
semantics.instance_rule: Each REST instance has an explicit stable logical name/identity.
semantics.listener_rule: REST instance binds to an exact named listener.
semantics.method_rule: HTTP method semantics are explicit per route.
semantics.payload_rule: Request/response schema and content profile are explicit.
semantics.port_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] REST port is configurable; no universal default REST port is locked. [2] No universal default REST port is assumed unless explicitly configured.
semantics.route_rule: REST routes map to exact canonical resources/operations.
semantics.runtime_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] declared, enabled and running states remain separate. [2] Start/stop/reload changes runtime state without changing REST instance identity.
semantics.surface_rule: REST routes expose explicitly bound canonical operations/resources.
